segments.speaker: You
segments.text: Morning, both. Three things today: the shop, the photos, and whether the launch date still holds.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: The shop's mostly there. Products, the cart and the account pages work. Checkout needs another few days because of the shipping rules.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Jonas wants the islands too, and the carriers price them differently. If we start with the mainland, I can have checkout on staging by the weekend.

segments.speaker: You
segments.text: Let's do the mainland first. I'll confirm the zones with Jonas tomorrow.

segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: Photos: we shot the beans and the cups on Thursday. I'm editing them now, and they'll be in the shared folder in two days. The bags still look a bit flat, so I might reshoot those.

segments.speaker: You
segments.text: Fine by me, as long as it doesn't move the launch.

segments.speaker: Sam
segments.text: It won't. Worst case we launch with the current bag photos and swap them later.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: One more thing: gift cards. They're on the list, but they need their own checkout flow. I'd leave them until after the launch.

segments.speaker: You
segments.text: Agreed, gift cards after the launch. So the date stays as it is?

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Yes, if the shipping zones are settled this week.

segments.speaker: You
segments.text: Great. Same time next week, and I'll write up the actions.
